title: The inclined plane
prompt: a ramp-and-weight demonstration rig on a table with three buttons: “Raise” lifts a block vertically with a force gauge; “Ramp” pulls the same block up the slope with less force over a longer distance; “Steepen” raises the slope and increases the pulling force; see-through reveals the sliding carriage, rope path and matching work measurements
blurb: A teaching adaptation shows how a ramp trades a longer pull for less force while ideal work equals the load's energy gain.
